sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Changes in CT Radiomic Features Associated with Lymphocyte Distribution Predict Overall Survival and Response to Immunotherapy in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】We found that DelRADx patterns could predict response to ICI therapy and overall survival (OS) for patients with NSCLC.

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】The LDA classifier yielded an AUC of 0.88 ± 0.08 in distinguishing responders from nonresponders in D1, and 0.85 and 0.81 in D2 and D3 DRS was associated with OS [HR: 1.64; 95% confidence interval (CI), 1.22-2.21; P = 0.0011; C-index = 0.72).

evidence.text: We found that DelRADx patterns could predict response to ICI therapy and overall survival (OS) for patients with NSCLC.

The LDA classifier yielded an AUC of 0.88 ± 0.08 in distinguishing responders from nonresponders in D1, and 0.85 and 0.81 in D2 and D3 DRS was associated with OS [HR: 1.64; 95% confidence interval (CI), 1.22-2.21; P = 0.0011; C-index = 0.72).
